sections.title: An Aiken firm, *Aiken-raised*
body: Overstreet & Associates CPAs is a certified public accounting firm in Woodside Executive Court.
Troy Overstreet, the CPA who leads it, is a life-long resident of Aiken County and a member of the AICPA and the South Carolina Association of CPAs.

items.a: Tax preparation is one of the firm's services. Call (803) 226-0101 to ask about yours.
Woodside Executive Court in Aiken. Directories give both 6250 and 6270 as the street number; call for directions.

items.q: Can you help me plan, not just file?
items.a: Yes. Tax planning is one of the firm's core services.

sections.title: Tax season is coming.
sections.text: Call the office in Woodside Executive Court.
